# Bluestream

> > Bluestream delivers turnkey urban design and street furniture solutions across the UAE, specializing in bollards, benches, litter bins, and custom-manufactured products for smart cities.

Bluestream provides comprehensive street furniture and urban infrastructure solutions for Dubai and the wider UAE market, focusing on traffic management, pedestrian safety, and sustainable city design. Their product range includes the Taurus bollard series, Luma benches, and Heritage waste management systems, all customizable to meet specific urban landscape requirements.

## Key Topics

- Street furniture solutions
- Urban design and planning
- Traffic management systems
- Pedestrian safety infrastructure
- Stainless steel bollards (Taurus series)
- Outdoor benches and seating (Luma)
- Waste management systems (Heritage, Nord)
- Custom manufacturing and modular products
- Smart city solutions
- Sustainability in urban spaces
- RAL color standards (1013, 7016, 9005)
- Dubai and UAE urban projects
- Iroko wood products
- Storefront protection
- Customizable urban furniture
